retired.question: แต่ละโรงเรียนตอนนี้มีนักเรียนอยู่กี่คน
retired.gold_sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_term enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND school.school_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY student_count DESC, school.id ASC

retired.question: รวมวันที่เด็กมาสายของแต่ละ ร.ร. ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
retired.gold_sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(*)::int AS late_student_day_count FROM attendance_day day JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = day.student_uuid JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE day."AttendanceStatus" = 3 AND day."AttendanceDate" >= '2026-06-01'::date AND day."AttendanceDate" < '2026-09-01'::date AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY late_student_day_count DESC, school.id ASC

retired.question: จำนวนนักเรียนปัจจุบันที่ขาดเรียนติดต่อกันเกิน 3 วัน แยกตามโรงเรียน
retired.gold_sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution ce ON ce.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND ce.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND ce.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = risk.school_id WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND risk.consecutive_absent_days > 3 GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY student_count DESC, school.id ASC
